# CANDIDATE: GAP_FADE_VWAP_PULLBACK_SHORT

**Filed:** 2026-07-09
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)
**Type:** new_trigger
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

An early gap up that loses vigor and retraces to VWAP with weak volume often reverses, offering a short opportunity. This edge exists because initial gap-up momentum frequently exhausts without follow-through buying, allowing mean reversion to the intraday VWAP as weak-handed longs liquidate.

## Mechanism

Entry: If opening price gaps up >0.5% from prior close AND within first 15 minutes price returns to VWAP forming a bearish candle (close < open) with upper wick ≥2× body AND volume < average volume of first 5-minute bars, enter short at candle close. Exit: Chart-stop at high of gap bar, initial target at 1R (distance from entry to stop), runner trailed at 10% below highest high since entry. Regime filter: Only active when VIX between 15-25 and first hour of trading (09:30-10:30 ET); skip if gap volume >2× average of first 5-minute bars (suggests continuation).

## OP-20 disclosures

1. **Account-size assumption:** qty=28 requires $25K+ account; $1K paper account ≈14% of headline P&L (scales linearly with contracts)
2. **Sample bias:** Zero-sample proposal; high overfit risk until validated on historical data. Selection based solely on thesis without empirical screening.
3. **Out-of-sample:** NEEDS-OOS (no walk-forward or held-out testing performed)
4. **Real-fills:** NEEDS-REAL-FILLS (no realistic slippage/spread simulation on top 3 J days)
5. **Failure modes:** 
   - Worst day: Strong gap-up continuation triggering chart-stop loss (e.g., 5/05 if gap persists)
   - Max drawdown: Consecutive losing days in persistent uptrend regime (e.g., multiple gap-up days in bull market)
   - Blow-up scenario: Volatility expansion causing repeated whipsaws (e.g., gap-up/fade patterns failing during market stress)
6. **Concentration:** unknown -- requires Stage-1 backtest (cannot estimate top-5 days contribution without backtest)
